verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-document and services platform, so e-signature audit trails and completion certificates are a fair question for it. The evidence pack only covers business formation, registered agent, compliance reminders, cloud storage and customizable documents. Nothing mentions e-signing, tamper-evident audit trails or completion certificates.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
